question: Should OpenClaw accept `AssembleResult.referenceContext` and `reference-context` as public context-engine SDK surface now, require an experimental/internal seam first, or pause this implementation until a maintainer sponsors the API?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and backed by Codex source proof, but merging establishes a plugin SDK contract and prompt-authority boundary that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Require sponsored or experimental API before merge
options.body: Ask the author to either get explicit maintainer sponsorship for the stable SDK contract or narrow/mark the lane as experimental/internal before merge.

options.title: Accept the stable SDK lane
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the compatibility and authority-boundary risk and proceed through normal merge gates.

options.title: Pause until API sponsorship
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88753 open and pause or close this implementation until the context-engine API direction is maintainer-owned.

recommendation.title: Require sponsored or experimental API before merge
recommendation.body: Ask the author to either get explicit maintainer sponsorship for the stable SDK contract or narrow/mark the lane as experimental/internal before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is primarily about the public context-engine contract and host-capability model, where history and CONTRIBUTING ownership point to jalehman.
